description: This Java source file defines the class MidiFramer, which extends MidiReceiver. It contains logic to parse a stream of MIDI bytes into discrete MIDI messages, handling various MIDI message types, running status, and system exclusive (SysEx) messages.

classes.name: MidiFramer
classes.description: A class that converts a stream of MIDI bytes into individual MIDI messages and forwards them to a specified MidiReceiver, handling special cases like running status and SysEx messages.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides the MidiReceiver's onSend method to parse incoming MIDI byte stream and send complete MIDI messages to the underlying receiver, managing SysEx messages and running status.
